title: Invariant Rings of Adjacent-Quadratic Triangular Derivations
summary: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic zero and $D_N(a_n)=a_{n+1}a_{n+2}$ the adjacent-quadratic locally nilpotent derivation on $A_N=k[a_0,\dots,a_N]$. We determine the invariant ring at $N=5$, where deleting $a_0$ gives the polynomial base kernel $B^{D_5}=K=k[p,q,J_1,J_2]$, so localization gives the polynomial-line invariant algebra $(A_5^{D_5})_{pq}=K_{pq}[W]$ with $W=F_0/(p^2q^4)$, but this does not by itself determine the global kernel.
